text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait approves deployment of more U.S. troops.
- Public Investment Authority to sell 50 million government-owned shares in Gulf Insurance Company in a public auction on September 29.
- Public health minister says government cuts allowance allocated for medical treatment abroad to seven million dinars for the fiscal year 1996-97.
- Egypt is leading Arab market for attracting Kuwaiti investments, finance minister says.
- Emir calls for international support to end intimidation by Iraqi President Saddam Hussein.
- Some deputies of parliament admit receiving exceptional salaries yet ask for more.

- Kuwaiti government requests that a report prepared by a fact finding parliamentary committeee reviewing events leading up to the 1990 Iraqi invasion be referred without debate to the cabinet for study.
